title: Moments and Large Geometric Monodromy for Linearly Constrained Kloosterman Families
summary: Let $q=p^a$ with $p$ prime, $λ\in\mathbb F_p^\times$, and $ψ_q=ψ\circ\mathrm{Tr}_{\mathbb F_q/\mathbb F_p}$ for a nontrivial additive character $ψ$ of $\mathbb F_p$. For $n\ge2$ we study $Σ_n(h)=\sum_{u\in(\mathbb F_q^\times)^n,\sum_i h_i u_i=-λ}ψ_q(\sum_i u_i^{-1})$. On $\mathbb G_m^n$ we construct a lisse sheaf $\mathcal W_n$, pure of weight $n+1$ and rank $r(n)=2^n-\binom n{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$, whose Frobenius traces equal $(-1)^{n-1}qΣ_n(h)$ minus an explicit polynomial in $q$, for $h\in(\mathbb F_q^\times)^n$. For odd $p$, its geometric monodromy has identity component…
